# meca-limpia-bosque (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F9, Templo del Bosque), A: both ADULT at the entrance; room 06 cleared (its Bool and an enemy counter's key), B entering later.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 12-bosque
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 231
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Room06_Cleard \(0x3fde3897\) = 1: queued within limpia..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x3fde3897 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0x08b97cf063ef1790 = 1: queued within contador..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0x8b97cf063ef1790 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within contador..end
#! expect A coop: test flag ForestTemple_Room09_In \(0xa5a4441d\) = 1: queued within sensor..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0xa5a4441d 
mark start
warp ForestTemple ForestTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark limpia
flag ForestTemple_Room06_Cleard 1
wait 300
mark contador
key 0x08b97cf063ef1790 1   # Obj_EnemyCounter_A_01
wait 300
mark sensor
flag ForestTemple_Room09_In 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
